correctness.rationale: The bracket is alternating and satisfies Jacobi on basis triples; its brackets span the algebra. The symmetric-biderivation identity is a finite linear system with 18 unknowns and rank 11 over F2. The seven displayed free parameters give solutions, are independent, and exhaust the nullspace. The same coefficient matrix works over every characteristic-two field.

value.rationale: The result is an exact, reproducible classification of the full symmetric-biderivation space for a dimension-minimal perfect Lie algebra in characteristic two. It gives the complete seven-parameter space, not just a single counterexample, and identifies a concrete characteristic boundary in recent biderivation theory.
